findings.decision_effect: Mount the browser fixture itself at the canonical /workspace container root for every dependency, compile, package, and test command.
findings.finding: The clean runner mounted the repository root rather than the fixture root at /workspace. Jason preserves a dependency source path in macro literals, so checkout-relative nesting changed one packaged BEAM and the enclosing AVM identity.

findings.decision_effect: Retain the assigned server-log Path on the process object and hash that exact path during finalization instead of deriving a name from the later command count.
findings.finding: The server starts before ten browser commands are appended. Finalization recomputed its filename from the later list length, so it requested log 30 although the retained server log was assigned sequence 20.

findings.decision_effect: Locate the pending profile-server command record by command identity during finalization and update that record rather than indexing the final command in the expanded list.
findings.finding: The path correction retained the right server log but finalization still wrote its hash through self.commands[-1]. Ten browser commands had been appended since startup, leaving the actual server record pending and corrupting the final browser command hash.

rules: Preserve this baseline and every favorable and unfavorable source record.
Name this baseline in any superseding record and explain every changed binding.
Invalidate and repeat each active proof affected by a trigger before promotion.
Reactivate deferred evidence when its environment becomes available or BH-22 begins.
Rollback means selecting a prior immutable baseline, never rewriting its contents.
Amendments that change meaning require a new semantic baseline version.
